title: Free represented abelian sheaf and distinct étale configuration locus
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], with the universes of [def-weil-size-convention], and let $X$ be an algebraic space over $S$ with small étale site $X_{\mathrm{et}}$ [def-trf-algebraic-space]. For an object $U$ of this site define $\mathbf Z[U]$ to be the abelian sheafification [def-weil-pbc-sheafification] of the presheaf $V\mapsto\mathbf Z[\operatorname{Hom}_{X_{\mathrm{et}}}(V,U)]$ of free abelian groups, with restriction by precomposition; use the canonical universe lift to abelian groups in universe $u+1$. For any objects $U,T$ of this site, integer $n\geq0$ and arrows $\operatorname{pr}_i:T\to U$ indexed by $i\in\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, define the distinct-configuration subset of the underlying scheme of $T$ to be $\{x\in|T|:\ x\notin\operatorname{im}(|\operatorname{Eq}(\operatorname{pr}_i,\operatorname{pr}_j)|\to|T|)\text{ for every }i\ne j\}$, where each equalizer is taken between the underlying scheme morphisms. This defines the subset without asserting it is open or closed or imposing a product condition on $T$.
